title: Patch: the AI prices unevolved Evolve cards for what they become
thread:
**Issue #4648 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4648: Patch: the AI prices unevolved Evolve cards for what they become
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some newer units transform once, mid-game, when something happens: the board fills up, the hand holds enough free cards, a starship launches, a friend dies, or the unit itself takes a hit and lives. The practice opponent currently values each of those units only for the stats printed on it today. So it will not make a move whose only point is to set the transformation up, it will not guard a unit that is one step away from transforming, and it will not remove the other side's unit before it transforms.

After this is built it does. A concrete example: a 2/2 that grows by +4/+4 once every lane on its side is full. Today the opponent leaves its last lane empty and the card stays small. After the change it fills that lane, guards the small unit for the turn it needs, and breaks up the other side's full board before their copy grows.

## Why

- Evolve is a set-wide mechanic, not one card: the standing and trigger conditions are defined in `spec/06-keywords.md`, with rulings `R3536000` (a card evolves once), `R3536001` (the standing and event conditions), `R3536002` (marked library cards evolve as they enter) and `R3536003` (cards that run Evolve text extra times), and dozens of card rows in `spec/08-catalog.md` (for example S+ Lone Drifter, Gargantuar, Astrophage, Jay Fungus).
- The AI scores no Evolve text anywhere: a search over `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `candidates.rs`, `search.rs`, `simulate.rs`, `lethal.rs`, `mulligan.rs` and `deck.rs` for `evolv`/`Evolv` returns nothing. The only Evolve-adjacent coverage is the Wasp/Hornet attack-hook test in `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, which scores the summoned copy, not the transformation; `crates/ai/src/observe.rs` only strips the `evolved`/`entersEvolved` marks from hidden cards, which is correct. So an unevolved card is always worth exactly its current body, except where the transformation happens to fire inside one already-simulated line.
- This is the loss shape the training notes keep describing: engines and growers priced at today's body and left unanswered (`training/improve.md`, The first job). Dormant cards already got the analogous treatment (`slumber_worth` prices the woken unit by share, `R2380000`, `R3064000`); Evolve never did.
- Nothing open or recently closed covers it. The issue list has no Evolve-valuation item (nearest AI items are #4608 on cross-world lethal confirmation and #4554 on turn-hook/activation shares), and the never-again list has none either (nearest are #4514 on trap elimination and #4533 on the reply spending credits, both different mechanisms).

## Proposal

1. At the root of a decision, probe each readable unevolved Evolve card's transformation in a sandbox copy, following the existing Death / turn-hook / activation / awakening root probes, and add a share of the gain to that card's worth. Scale the share by how close a standing condition is (lanes filled, free cards held) and keep event conditions at a smaller baseline.
2. Let the existing move ordering feel that worth, so setup moves (filling the last lane, keeping the free cards, holding the pre-transformation unit back) and answers (removing the enemy's pre-transformation unit first) surface without special-casing every condition. Count the extra-run aura for Evolve text where it acts.
3. Put the shares and any caps behind named constants in the AI config with one switch, mirroring the Dormant shares, defaulting to on. Keep reading nothing hidden: hidden cards stay stripped of both Evolve marks, as they are now.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`: the worth addition and the root probe, next to `death_prices`, `turn_hook_prices`, `activation_prices` and `awaken_prices`.
- `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`: ordering so setup and answering moves surface.
- `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: the named shares and switch (project rule 9).
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/evolve.rs` (new): scenario tests for setup, guard and answer play.
- SPEC sections: `SPEC §6.3` (`spec/06-keywords.md`, Evolve rows), `SPEC §9.9` (the AI), rulings `R3536000`, `R3536001`, `R3536002`, `R3536003`; context in `training/improve.md` (The first job).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New tests show an unevolved Evolve card is worth more than its bare body, with the share shrinking as its condition gets farther (e.g. four lanes filled vs one filled).
- [ ] A scenario test shows the AI making a setup move it scores negatively at body value (e.g. filling the last lane for the transformation).
- [ ] A scenario test shows the AI answering an enemy pre-transformation unit it would ignore at body value.
- [ ] Hidden Evolve marks stay hidden: existing redact tests pass and the new probe reads only readable cards.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` are green.
- [ ] Every new number is a named constant; no tuning value is inlined.

## Size and risks

Size is hard (AI work per the repo's difficulty rules): about three source files plus one test file, verified through the AI gate's standard matchups. The main risk is overpaying for transformations that rarely fire (for example below-half-health conditions inviting bad trades); the condition-closeness scaling and the gate contain it. Rejected alternative: leaving Evolve to whatever fires inside simulated lines (the status quo), which keeps all setup and answering play blind. A bigger alternative, full information-set search over hidden marks, is a separate project, not this patch.

## Plan

## Goal

The practice opponent prices each readable unevolved Evolve unit on either field for a share of what its Evolve text gives, scaled by how close its standing condition is (lanes filled, free cards held, damage toward half) with event conditions at a smaller baseline. Setup moves toward a transformation and answers to enemy pre-transformation units then surface through the existing move order, which already scores removals and trades through `unit_worth` with prices. One ruling, one switch, all shares behind named constants; hidden Evolve marks stay stripped.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | `EvolvePrice` type; `Prices.evolutions` + `NONE`; `has_evolve_text`, `evolve_closeness`, `evolve_price`, `evolve_once`, `evolve_probe`, `evolve_prices`; `unit_worth` addition; module-doc line |
| `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` | change | Import `evolve_prices`; call it in `decision_prices`; doc comment (the `Prices` literal at `plan` needs nothing, it uses struct-update) |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `EvalWeights.evolve`, `evolve_event_share`, `evolve_read`; `AI_EVAL` values; `GREEDY_EVAL` zeros; `AI_EVOLVE_PROBE_NODES`, `AI_EVOLVE_ZERO_TOPUP_MAX`; `AI_DECISION_PRICE_NODES` sum; one range assert |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/evolve.rs` | new | Six `r4648000_…` tests (below) |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | `pub mod evolve;` between `even_trades` and `exile` |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | `Prices` paragraph and a per-price Evolve paragraph beside the attack-hook/awaken ones |
| `spec/rulings/R4648000.md` | new | Ruling note (lowest free in issue 4648's block; verified none exists) |
| `spec/pending/4648.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for the ruling |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | One Evolve sentence appended to the Evaluation bullet, carrying `[[R4648000]]` |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai/src/features.rs` (`UNCOUNTED_KEYWORDS` is the frozen learned-feature layout), `candidates.rs`, `reply.rs`, `observe.rs` (both Evolve marks already stripped), `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`. Governing spec: §6.2 (`Evolves when`), §6.3 (`Evolve`), §9.9 (the AI); rulings `R3536000`, `R3536001`, `R3536002`, `R3536003` govern, `R2380000`/`R3064000` are the pattern precedent. No engine change, so no new engine ruling beyond the AI one.

## Steps

1. `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: add three `EvalWeights` fields with docs — `evolve: f64` (share of the probed Evolve gain counted in `unit_worth`, inside the Brittle share; `AI_EVAL` 0.5, untuned start as `R2424000`'s), `evolve_event_share: f64` (closeness baseline for event conditions and Stacked; `AI_EVAL` 0.25), `evolve_read: bool` (master switch; `AI_EVAL` true). `GREEDY_EVAL` gets 0.0, 0.0, false. Add `AI_EVOLVE_PROBE_NODES: usize = 24` (two nodes per card, as `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`) and `AI_EVOLVE_ZERO_TOPUP_MAX: i32 = 6` (classification bound covering the shipped thresholds 3/1, not tuning). Add the former to the `AI_DECISION_PRICE_NODES` sum. Add `const _: () = assert!(AI_EVAL.evolve_event_share >= 0.0 && AI_EVAL.evolve_event_share <= 1.0);`.
2. `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, prices plumbing: add `pub type EvolvePrice = ActivationPrice;` after the `AwakenPrice` section with an `R4648000` doc; add `pub evolutions: Vec<EvolvePrice>` to `Prices` (doc line beside the others) and `evolutions: Vec::new()` to `Prices::NONE`. Add `has_evolve_text` mirroring `has_wake_trigger` (`script_of(state, card).evolve.is_some()`; a Vanilla card has none). Extend the module doc's root-probe sentence with the Evolve probe.
3. `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, closeness: add `fn evolve_closeness(state: &GameState, card: &CardInstance, w: &EvalWeights) -> f64`, capped at 1.0. Return 0.0 when `!has_evolve_text` or `!can_evolve` (already evolved) or the card is slumbering (its text is off; import `can_evolve` via `jackioh_engine::evolution::{can_evolve, evolve_now}`, `HookArgs` and `is_empty` into the existing engine `use`). Return 1.0 when `enters_evolved == Some(true)` or when the card's own closure holds now (`script_of(state, card).evolves_when.as_ref().is_some_and(|when| when(HookArgs { state, self_: card, radiant: card.radiant }))`). Otherwise classify by flip-probing the same closure on throwaway clones (never settled, never stored): lanes — clone the state, fill each `is_empty` slot of the controller's unit row with a filler (a clone of the card with `id` set to `format!("evolve-filler-{}", lane)`, written via `get_mut` on `units[(lane as usize).saturating_sub(1)]`); if the closure holds, return filled/total on the real state. Free cards — count hand cards with `effective_cost == 0`; add up to `AI_EVOLVE_ZERO_TOPUP_MAX` filler hand cards (clones with distinct ids and `cost_mod` forcing cost 0); at the first `k` that flips the closure return `have / (have + k)`. Health — call the closure with a self-copy damaged just below half (`damage = max - max/2 + 1` off `unit_view`); if it flips return `(max - health) / max` on the real view (0 at full health, under 0.5 near half — this is what contains the bad-trade risk). Else return `w.evolve_event_share`.
4. `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, probe and worth: add `evolve_once` mirroring `wake_once` (one node; `settled_after(before, |sink| { if let Some(card) = find_instance(sink.state, id).cloned() { evolve_now(sink, &card); } })`; `None` when spent, `Some(None)` on panic/prompt/game-over). Add `evolve_probe` mirroring `awaken_probe`: evolve the card and its `hookless_twin` (Vanilla, so `evolve_now` is a no-op baseline; `with_text_back` before scoring), price = controller's `evaluate` after minus before plus `AI_EVAL.next_turn_mana` per crystal gained, signed. The extra-run aura (`R3536003`) needs no code: `begin` counts it inside the real branch. Add `evolve_prices` mirroring `awaken_prices` but field-only: guard on `!AI_EVAL.evolve_read || AI_EVAL.evolve == 0.0 || pending || result`; candidates are `active_units_of` of the seat then the opponent with `has_evolve_text && can_evolve` (never the enemy hand; no own-hand spawns — a hand card's play-then-evolve is one simulated line away and settle fires it); sandbox copy, auto-end-turn off, `create_sub_counter(counter, AI_EVOLVE_PROBE_NODES)`. Add `evolve_price` mirroring `attack_hook_price`: 0.0 at `!w.evolve_read || w.evolve == 0.0`, else `evolve_closeness * price` for the matching entry with text still present. In `unit_worth`, after the attack-hook block: `value += w.evolve * evolve_price(state, unit, w, prices);` (inside the Brittle share — a crumbled card never evolves). `kill_worth` then prices answers with no further change.
5. `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`: import `evolve_prices`, call it in `decision_prices` (`let evolutions = evolve_prices(probe, seat, counter);`, field in the returned `Prices`), extend that function's doc list with `R4648000`. No `candidates.rs`/`reply.rs` change: `front_value`, `trade_value`/`kill_worth` and `even_trade` already take `prices`, so removal answers and winning trades feel the worth; plays surface through priced line ends.
6. Docs and ruling: `crates/ai/README.md` — extend the `Prices` paragraph's ruling list and add the Evolve per-price paragraph after the attack-hook one. `spec/09-architecture.md` — append to the Evaluation bullet: the unevolved-Evolve sentence ending with `[[R4648000]]`. Write `spec/rulings/R4648000.md` (front matter `id`/`title`/`cards` naming §6.2, §6.3, §9.9, `R185`, `R345`, `R923000`, `R923001`, `R3536000`–`R3536003`, `R2380000`, `R3064000`, S+ #2, S+ #27, C+ #49, S+ #86; `proven_in: [crates/ai/tests/ai/evolve.rs]`; body: sandbox evolve vs hookless twin, closeness rules, field-only scope, no Hearthstone rule involved, rejected: engine condition enum, per-card special-casing, full information-set search). Write `spec/pending/4648.md` as `**[[R4648000]] … (issue #4648, 2026-11-23)**: …`.
7. Tests: create `crates/ai/tests/ai/evolve.rs` (six tests below) and register the module. Use `support::{register_cards, AI, HUMAN, close, unit}`; card ids: Lone Drifter `stinkyscapeplus-002`, Jay Fungus `classicplus-049` (free `core-010`, non-free `core-016`), Gargantuar `stinkyscapeplus-027`, Astrophage (confirm id in its script file), Mr. Vanilla `core-008`, Tempo Timmy `core-011` (verify cost/stats in the catalog first), Polymorph `meditative-024`.

## Tests

- `r4648000_pending_gain_scaled_by_lanes_filled`: AI field Drifter + 3 vanillas (4/5) vs Drifter alone (1/5). `evolve_prices` prices both, price > 0, nodes in `2..=AI_EVOLVE_PROBE_NODES`; `evaluate_priced − evaluate(NONE)` closes to `sign × 0.8/0.2 × AI_EVAL.evolve × price`; the 4/5 diff exceeds the 1/5 diff; under `GREEDY_EVAL` priced equals unpriced. Covers worth-above-body and shrinking share.
- `r4648000_more_free_cards_scores_more`: base Fungus with 2 free vs 0 free in hand; priced diffs ordered 2 > 0, each closing to `share × evolve × price` with shares 2/3 and 0.0 (0-free still counts the event-baseline? No — Fungus has a standing condition; at 0/3 closeness is 0.0, diff 0; assert that).
- `r4648000_event_condition_scores_baseline`: Astrophage on the field; priced diff closes to `AI_EVAL.evolve × AI_EVAL.evolve_event_share × price` exactly.
- `r4648000_decide_fills_a_lane_toward_evolution`: Radiant Drifter + 2 vanillas (3/5), hand filler + single-target answer, mana for exactly one. Assert `decide` plays the filler into the unit row AND `evaluate_priced(filler_end, NONE)` ranks below the answer line while priced ranks above. Note: this is partial progress by design — a last-lane fill evolves inside the simulated line via settle and is visible at body value too, so only the closeness delta can discriminate. Calibrate filler/answer/mana to satisfy `0 < R−F < evolve × G × 0.2`.
- `r4648000_decide_answers_enemy_pretransformation_unit`: enemy Drifter + 2 vanillas + Timmy 3/3 (enemy 4/5, closeness 0.8); AI hand Polymorph, mana 3. Assert `kill_worth` with `NONE` prefers Timmy but with prices prefers Drifter, and `decide` targets Drifter.
- `r4648000_enemy_hand_evolve_unpriced_and_marks_stay_hidden`: enemy hand holding Drifter yields no `HUMAN` entry from the hand; a state whose only Evolve cards are enemy-hand yields empty prices and 0 nodes.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai evolve`, then regressions `cargo test -p jackioh-ai slumber`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai attack_hook`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai observe`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai redact`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai decide`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo jackioh spec check`; `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` to close.

## Done when

- [ ] Unevolved Evolve units on either field count pending gain scaled by closeness; nearer counts more (tests 1–3).
- [ ] The AI makes a setup move that ranks below the alternative at body value (test 4).
- [ ] The AI answers an enemy pre-transformation unit it ignores at body value (test 5).
- [ ] Enemy-hand Evolve never priced; existing redact/observe tests green (test 6).
- [ ] Every new number is a named constant; `GREEDY_EVAL` reads none of it.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` green.
- [ ] Ruling note, pending paragraph, §9.9 sentence, AI README updated; nothing under `11-rulings.md`/`INDEX.md`/`CARDS.md`.

## Risks

- Overpaying for transformations that rarely fire (below-half health inviting bad trades): contained — full-health closeness is 0, near-half caps under 0.5, events sit at 0.25, and the AI gates watch the result. Values are untuned starts for the training lanes, recorded as such.
- Determinism/purity: probes run on sandbox clones under the pool hold on the copy's own stream (`settled_after`), as the other probes do; filler clones never leave the clones.
- Hidden information: the probe walks `active_units_of` (public boards) only; `observe.rs` stripping is untouched and covered by test 6 plus the existing suites.
- Approximation, recorded in the ruling: a backrow-standing Flying Evolve unit keeps body value (probe walks the unit row); the twin switches off all text, not only Evolve (no shipped card pairs Evolve with another same-event trigger).

## Open questions

None blocking. Tuning of `evolve`, `evolve_event_share` and the probe budget belongs to the training lanes after this ships, not to this patch.
```
